description: Files and folders under src/ whose errors are all coded, checked by tools/lint/error-codes.mjs. A folder ends with a slash. A plain Error, TypeError, RangeError or SyntaxError throw that has to stay is listed in retainedPlainThrows with the throw as written and the reason it stays.

retainedPlainThrows.throw: new TypeError()
retainedPlainThrows.reason: Thrown inside a try whose catch right below it returns a malformed or unresolved verification result; it never leaves verifyComponentSignature.

retainedPlainThrows.throw: new Error("artifact is not a JSON object")
retainedPlainThrows.reason: Thrown inside the try in write, whose catch right below it throws the coded binding.artifact_invalid error with this one as its cause.

retainedPlainThrows.throw: new Error(message)
retainedPlainThrows.reason: Thrown inside the try in queryCatalogPage, directly or through readBoundedJson, which is called only there; its catch returns an indeterminate result, so it never leaves the function.
